This channel is for livestream content from Japan! 🇯🇵
Walking street tours, exploring interesting locations, Q&A about life in Japan and more!
Hope to see you in the chat! 👋

Edited Japan videos are over on my MAIN CHANNEL: youtube.com/sharlainjapan
